[i]There are those who let life lead them by the reins… and then there are those who leap onto the back of a seething mad bull, prod it with a red-hot iron, and steer it straight into a china shop.[/i]

Jack Pakenham is the World☆Class Daredevil, someone who doesn’t recognize the word “impossible” as part of his expressive vocabulary. A top streamer best known for making a public spectacle of some of the most daring stunts and feats of human ingenuity the world has ever seen, he’s always on the lookout for ways to “spice things up.” His greatest achievement? Getting away with anything at all while his teacher, Ms. Sophia Alexandra, has her eye on him.

Likes: Physics, engineering, sugar, thrills, spectacle
Dislikes: Lectures, busywork
